newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commission stops, funds.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commission stops, funds.

text.p: WCE canola ended lower on fund selling and commission house stop loss selling, traders said.

"Funds sold 1,000 March late, commission sell stops were triggered and we broke chart support at $401.10 in the Jan," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $0.50, Mar-May at even money. January futures crush margin rose to -39.83 from -44.04 Monday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 6,403 lots, 200 hedges.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola fell $5.80 to $398.70, March lost $5.20 to $399.20. January flax fell $2.20 to $355.80 with scale down commercial demand. Jan-May $4, Jan-Mar $3. Volume was 505.
December feed wheat rose $0.90 to $162.60 on commercial and local buying, March fell $0.50 to $165.50 on local spreads of the March-May at $0.50. Volume was 1,150 lots.

February western barley lost $0.30 to $138.20, May down $0.30 to $138.70 on hedges, with feed lots buying and commission short covering. Feb-Mar spread at even money, Feb May $0.60. Volume was 1,350 lots.
Commercials sold 34 December oats down US$3 to US$119 and five May down US$4.50 to US$112.50. LFG sold 50 October peas down US$1 to US$187 to exporters.
(Values in Canadian dollars a tonne except peas, oats).
